# Retired CUA browser adapter

The former Dojo browser launcher, read-only CDP adapters and experimental
navigation writer were removed in the Browser Control migration. Their last
source hashes remain in `retired-browser-adapters.json`; CUA's literal imported
core remains pinned for policy, timestamps and perception. It is not exposed as
a second browser engine.

Current integration: [Browser Control](../../../docs/browser-control.md).
